article.title: Haley Stevens is trying to ratf–k the El-Sayed campaign over Israel
article.author: Michael Arria
article.content: In a shock move, Rep. Haley Stevens endorsed Republican Mike Rogers over fellow Democrat Abdul El-Sayed. While the exact reasons are unclear, there is no doubt Israel played a central role.
